title: Stocks making the biggest moves premarket: Intel, GameStop, Archer Aviation, Berkshire and more
summary: Major stocks including Intel, GameStop, Archer Aviation, and Berkshire Hathaway are experiencing significant premarket movements. Market activity suggests investor interest in several key sectors. These moves may signal broader market trends ahead of regular trading.
content: These are the stocks posting the largest moves premarket.

zh.title: 盘前大幅波动的股票：英特尔、游戏驿站、箭鸟航空、伯克希尔等
zh.summary: 包括英特尔、游戏驿站、箭鸟航空和伯克希尔哈撒韦在内的主要股票正在经历显著的盘前波动。市场活动表明投资者对多个关键行业感兴趣。这些走势可能预示着常规交易前更广泛的市场趋势。

title: Archer shares surge after Boeing stake, electric aircraft subsidiary deal
summary: Boeing is divesting three subsidiaries to Archer Aviation while simultaneously taking a strategic stake in the electric aircraft startup. The deal reflects Boeing's confidence in the eVTOL market and provides Archer with significant resources and backing. Archer shares surged on the announcement, signaling investor enthusiasm for the partnership.
content: Boeing is selling three of its subsidiaries to Archer Aviation in exchange for a stake in the eVTOL startup.

zh.title: 波音投资和电动飞行器子公司交易后，箭鸟股价飙升
zh.summary: 波音公司向箭鸟航空出售三个子公司，同时对这家电动飞行器初创公司进行战略投资。该交易反映了波音对电动垂直起降市场的信心，并为箭鸟提供了重要的资源和支持。箭鸟股价在宣布该协议后飙升，表明投资者对该合作伙伴关系充满热情。

title: Berkshire Hathaway finally started spending its nearly $400 billion in cash — on one stock it knows very well
summary: Berkshire Hathaway has begun deploying its massive $400 billion cash pile through stock buybacks of its own shares. The move marks a shift from years of cash accumulation under Warren Buffett's cautious approach. Market reactions are mixed, with some investors questioning the capital allocation decision.
content: Berkshire is buying its own stock after years of building up a cash pile. Not everyone is excited.

zh.title: 伯克希尔哈撒韦最终开始花掉其近4000亿美元现金——用于购买它非常熟悉的一只股票
zh.summary: 伯克希尔哈撒韦已开始通过回购自己的股票来部署其庞大的4000亿美元现金储备。此举标志着从沃伦·巴菲特谨慎方式下的多年现金积累的转变。市场反应不一，一些投资者对资本配置决策提出质疑。

title: Intel plans $15 billion stock offering as AI demand accelerates
summary: Intel is launching a $15 billion stock offering to fund expansion as AI infrastructure demand surges across the technology industry. The capital raise reflects broader trends of tech giants investing trillions to support AI development and deployment. This positions Intel to capture market share in the booming AI hardware segment.
content: Technology giants have shelled out trillions to support insatiable AI demand and the infrastructure buildout.

zh.title: 英特尔计划150亿美元股票发行，以应对AI需求加速
zh.summary: 英特尔推出150亿美元股票发行以资助扩张，因为AI基础设施需求在整个科技行业激增。这次融资反映了科技巨头投入数万亿美元支持AI开发和部署的更广泛趋势。这使英特尔能够在蓬勃发展的AI硬件市场中占据市场份额。

title: Apple’s stock could underperform, especially without an ‘all-glass’ iPhone, this analyst warns
summary: A Jefferies analyst warns that Apple's ability to improve profitability through more expensive devices may be limited without major innovations like an all-glass iPhone design. The analyst cites challenges in justifying premium pricing to consumers already facing affordability pressures. This suggests Apple stock could underperform relative to broader market expectations.
content: A Jefferies analyst says that it may be harder than it looks for Apple to roll out dramatically more expensive devices in a bid to boost profitability.

zh.title: 一位分析师警告苹果股票可能表现不佳，尤其是在没有"全玻璃"iPhone的情况下
zh.summary: 一位杰富瑞分析师警告，苹果通过更昂贵的设备提高盈利能力的能力可能受到限制，除非有全玻璃iPhone设计这样的重大创新。分析师指出，对于已经面临负担压力的消费者来说，为高端定价辩护存在挑战。这表明苹果股票可能相对于更广泛的市场预期表现不佳。

title: Interest rates may stay higher for longer. What that means for consumers
summary: If elevated interest rates persist longer than expected, consumers could face higher borrowing costs at a time when affordability is already strained. The extended period of higher rates would impact mortgages, auto loans, and credit card debt. This could further pressure household finances and consumer spending power.
content: Any move toward higher rates would increase borrowing costs for consumers at a time when affordability pressures are already mounting.

zh.title: 利率可能会保持在较高水平更长时间。这对消费者意味着什么
zh.summary: 如果高利率持续的时间比预期的要长，消费者可能面临更高的借贷成本，而此时负担能力已经捉襟见肘。高利率期限延长将影响抵押贷款、汽车贷款和信用卡债务。这可能进一步增加家庭财务压力和消费支出能力。

title: Meta to open source its most powerful AI model as it takes swipe at OpenAI, Anthropic
summary: Meta is releasing its most powerful AI models open-source, including Muse Glimmer and the forthcoming Muse Spark 1.2 weights. The move positions Meta as an alternative to proprietary systems from OpenAI and Anthropic while advancing Zuckerberg's vision for U.S. AI leadership. Open-source AI is becoming a key competitive differentiator in the market.
content: Meta launched Muse Glimmer and plans to release Muse Spark 1.2 weights as Zuckerberg pushes for U.S. leadership in open AI.

zh.title: Meta 开源其最强大的 AI 模型，挑战 OpenAI 和 Anthropic
zh.summary: Meta 正在开源其最强大的 AI 模型，包括 Muse Glimmer 和即将推出的 Muse Spark 1.2 权重。此举将 Meta 定位为 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 专有系统的替代方案，同时推进扎克伯格对美国 AI 领导力的愿景。开源 AI 正在成为市场的关键竞争优势。

title: New school uniform rules won't cut costs, says mum
summary: A parent argues that new school uniform regulations will not reduce costs for families, noting that schools could achieve similar branding through cheaper iron-on badges instead. The criticism highlights concerns about uniform policies adding financial burden during a time of rising school costs. This reflects ongoing debates about how schools can manage expenses while maintaining dress codes.
content: Michaela Wilson says she has "no idea why schools don't just sell iron-on branded badges".

zh.title: 新校服规定不会降低成本，一位母亲表示
zh.summary: 一位家长辩称新的校服规定不会降低家庭成本，并指出学校可以通过更便宜的熨烫徽章达到类似的品牌效果。这一批评突出了在学校成本上升期间，校服政策会增加财务负担的担忧。这反映了关于学校如何在保持着装规范的同时管理支出的持续争论。

title: Intel plans to sell $15 billion worth of stock after it has risen 400% in a year
summary: Intel is launching a $15 billion stock offering following a dramatic 400% surge in its stock price over the past year. The company plans to use proceeds to fund expansion in physical AI, custom chips, and advanced packaging technologies. The offering capitalizes on strong investor sentiment while providing capital for strategic initiatives.
content: The company said it sees growth opportunities in physical AI, custom chips and advanced packaging.

zh.title: 英特尔计划出售 150 亿美元股票，此前股价在一年内飙升了 400%
zh.summary: 英特尔在过去一年股价剧增 400% 后，正在启动 150 亿美元的股票发行。该公司计划使用所得资金扩展物理 AI、定制芯片和先进封装技术的业务。此发行利用了强劲的投资者情绪，同时为战略举措提供了资本。

title: Here are Monday's biggest analyst calls: Nvidia, Apple, SpaceX, Dick's, Micron, Broadcom, Microsoft & more
summary: Wall Street analysts issued significant calls on multiple stocks including Nvidia, Apple, SpaceX, Dick's Sporting Goods, Micron, Broadcom, and Microsoft on Monday. These analyst recommendations reflect updates on company performance, industry trends, and valuation assessments. Such calls influence investor sentiment and trading decisions across major market segments.
content: Here are the biggest calls on Wall Street on Monday.

zh.title: 周一最重要的分析师评级：英伟达、苹果、SpaceX、迪克体育、美光、博通、微软及更多
zh.summary: 华尔街分析师周一对包括英伟达、苹果、SpaceX、迪克体育用品公司、美光、博通和微软在内的多只股票发布了重要评级。这些分析师建议反映了公司业绩、行业趋势和估值评估的更新。此类评级影响投资者情绪和主要市场的交易决策。

title: Student loan borrowers face steeper 'marriage penalty' under new repayment plan
summary: Recent changes to federal student loan repayment plans may penalize married couples who have higher combined incomes relative to single borrowers, creating a marriage penalty. Married borrowers should carefully evaluate their options under the new income-driven repayment framework. This development highlights how federal loan policies can have unintended consequences for different household situations.
content: Recent changes to the federal student loan system could impact married couples. Here's what borrowers should consider.

zh.title: 学生贷款借款人在新还款计划下面临更严重的"婚姻惩罚"
zh.summary: 联邦学生贷款还款计划的最近变化可能对已婚夫妇造成惩罚，因为他们的联合收入相对于单身借款人通常更高，从而产生婚姻惩罚。已婚借款人应在新的收入驱动还款框架下仔细评估自己的选择。这一发展凸显了联邦贷款政策对不同家庭情况可能产生的意外后果。

title: This company is set to gain ground on sky-high computer hardware demand, Morgan Stanley says
summary: Morgan Stanley identifies Hewlett Packard Enterprise as a major beneficiary of surging demand for computer hardware driven by the AI boom. The analyst expects HPE to gain market share as enterprise customers expand infrastructure to support AI applications. Strong hardware demand is expected to sustain growth as companies invest in AI capabilities.
content: Hewlett Packard Enterprise has even more room to run as demand for hardware remains strong due to the AI boom, per Morgan Stanley.

zh.title: 摩根士丹利表示，这家公司有望在飙升的计算机硬件需求中获益
zh.summary: 摩根士丹利指出，惠普企业是人工智能热潮推动的计算机硬件需求激增的主要受益者。该分析师预期随着企业客户扩展基础设施以支持人工智能应用，HPE将获得市场份额。随着公司投资人工智能能力，预计强劲的硬件需求将继续支持增长。

title: Thames Water gave finance boss a £1m signing-on fee
summary: Thames Water paid its new finance boss Steve Buck a £1 million signing-on fee to attract him to the troubled utility company. The substantial signing bonus highlights competitive pressures for executive talent despite the company's financial challenges. The payment has drawn public scrutiny regarding executive compensation at struggling firms.
content: The seven-figure payment was given to Steve Buck as part of package to persuade him to join the troubled utility company.

zh.title: 泰晤士水务公司向财务总监支付100万英镑签字费
zh.summary: 泰晤士水务公司向新聘财务总监史蒂夫·巴克支付了100万英镑的签字费,以吸引他加入这家陷入困境的公用事业公司。这笔巨大的签字奖金突显了尽管公司面临财务挑战,但对高管人才的竞争压力。这笔款项已引起公众对陷入困境企业高管薪酬的审视。

title: Are target date funds aggressive enough to give Americans retirement savings that last their lifetimes?
summary: Industry experts are questioning whether target date funds—popular default retirement investments—are sufficiently aggressive to generate returns that can sustain retirees through decades of retirement. As life expectancy increases and returns remain uncertain, more aggressive allocations may be necessary for adequate retirement security. This debate highlights the tradeoffs between risk and guaranteed retirement income.
content: The popular default investments may need to be more aggressive in order to fund decades of retirement.

zh.title: 目标日期基金是否足够激进,能为美国人提供终身的退休储蓄?
zh.summary: 行业专家质疑目标日期基金——流行的默认退休投资——是否足够激进,能产生足以维持退休人士数十年退休生活的回报。随着预期寿命增加和回报仍存不确定性,可能需要更激进的配置以确保充足的退休保障。这场辩论突出了风险与保证退休收入之间的权衡。

title: ‘I want her to choose the best strategy’: My wife’s Social Security is just $900. Should she claim spousal benefit at 62?
summary: A retiree seeks guidance on Social Security claiming strategy for his wife whose benefits total only $900 monthly due to limited earnings history as a school teacher. The question involves weighing the tradeoff between claiming spousal benefits at 62 versus waiting for potentially higher benefits later. This illustrates how individuals with non-traditional work histories face complex Social Security decisions.
content: “She was a teacher at a school district, so didn’t put much into Social Security.”

zh.title: "我想让她选择最佳策略":妻子的社会保障金只有900美元。她应该在62岁时申请配偶福利吗?
zh.summary: 一位退休人士为其妻子的社会保障申请策略寻求指导。其妻子由于作为学校教师的收入历史有限,每月福利仅为900美元。这个问题涉及权衡在62岁时申请配偶福利与等待以后可能更高福利之间的利弊。这说明了具有非传统工作历史的个人面临的复杂社会保障决定。

title: Burnham brings forward ban on 'subscription traps' to ease cost of living
summary: The UK Prime Minister is advancing a ban on 'subscription traps' as part of efforts to reduce living costs for consumers. This announcement comes as part of a broader UK tour focused on addressing cost-of-living concerns.
content: The prime minister is embarking on a UK tour with a series of announcements aimed at easing living costs.

zh.title: 伯纳姆推进禁止"订阅陷阱"以缓解生活成本
zh.summary: 英国首相正推进禁止"订阅陷阱"的措施，以帮助减轻消费者的生活成本。这一宣布是更广泛的英国访问活动的一部分，旨在解决生活成本问题。

title: Australian rare earth miner surges as much as 29% after U.S. Department of War investment
summary: An Australian rare earth mining company surged up to 29% following U.S. Department of War investment backing for a scandium mine project. The Trump administration is supporting the initiative to reduce China's dominance in critical minerals.
content: The Trump administration has backed plans to build an Australian scandium mine as part of a push to challenge China’s critical-minerals dominance.

zh.title: 澳大利亚稀土矿商因美国国防部投资激增29%
zh.summary: 澳大利亚稀土矿业公司在获得美国国防部对钪矿项目的投资支持后，股价暴涨至29%。特朗普政府正在支持该举措以减少中国在关键矿物领域的主导地位。

title: Tech leaders say AI means less work - their staff say they work up to 90 hours a week
summary: Tech company leaders claim AI will reduce work burdens and increase free time, but employees report working 90-hour weeks, revealing a significant gap between executive rhetoric and workplace reality. The discrepancy highlights ongoing questions about AI's actual impact on work conditions.
content: Tech companies are not modelling their own claims of the technology giving people more free time.

zh.title: 科技领袖称人工智能意味着工作减少——员工称他们每周工作90小时
zh.summary: 科技公司领导人声称人工智能将减少工作负担并增加闲暇时间，但员工报告每周工作长达90小时，这暴露了高管言辞与工作场所现实之间的巨大差距。这种矛盾突显了人工智能对工作条件的实际影响仍存在的疑问。

title: Trump says oil supermajors are making too much money. What will they do with it?
summary: Former President Trump has criticized oil supermajors like Exxon Mobil and Chevron for generating excessive profits, triggering political and environmental backlash. The windfall profits remain a point of contention in energy policy debates.
content: The windfall is fueling fresh political and environmental backlash, with Trump accusing Exxon Mobil and Chevron of making “too much money.”

zh.title: 特朗普称石油超级公司利润过高，他们将如何利用这些利润？
zh.summary: 前总统特朗普批评埃克森美孚和雪佛龙等石油超级公司产生过度利润，引发政治和环保反弹。这些意外利润仍然是能源政策辩论中的争议焦点。

title: U.S. reaffirms grip on Hormuz blockade, turning away 55 ships as talks stall
summary: The U.S. has turned away 55 ships as it maintains control of the Strait of Hormuz while diplomatic negotiations remain stalled. The ongoing blockade has disrupted regional shipping for over five months.
content: The escalating tally underscores how far the two sides remain from resolving a crisis that has choked the Strait of Hormuz for more than five months.

zh.title: 美国重申对霍尔木兹海峡的控制，拒绝55艘船只驶入，谈判陷入僵局
zh.summary: 美国在维持对霍尔木兹海峡控制权的同时拒绝了55艘船只驶入，外交谈判仍处于停滞状态。这一持续的封锁已经中断地区航运超过五个月。

title: Taylor Farms recalls salsa and guacamole over salmonella risk
summary: Taylor Farms voluntarily recalled salsa and guacamole products due to salmonella risk after being notified of contaminated fresh peppers from a supplier. The recall affects multiple salsa and guacamole products distributed through the company.
content: The supplier voluntarily recalled the products, including salsas and guacamole, after being notified that Coast Citrus Distributors was recalling fresh peppers.

zh.title: 泰勒农场因沙门氏菌风险召回莎莎酱和鳄梨酱
zh.summary: 泰勒农场在得知供应商的新鲜辣椒受到污染后，自愿召回莎莎酱和鳄梨酱产品以防止沙门氏菌风险。该召回影响了通过该公司分销的多种莎莎酱和鳄梨酱产品。

title: U.S. stock futures dip as investors await inflation data, grapple with more Iran uncertainty
summary: U.S. stock-index futures remained largely stable as investors monitored Iran's renewed demands that threaten to jeopardize the Strait of Hormuz reopening deal, while awaiting critical inflation data later in the week.
content: U.S. stock-index futures were little changed on Sunday, after new demands from Iran raised fresh doubts about the Strait of Hormuz reopening anytime soon and as investors await key inflation data later this week.

zh.title: 美国股指期货下跌，投资者等待通胀数据并应对伊朗不确定性
zh.summary: 美国股指期货基本保持稳定，投资者监视伊朗新提出的可能危害霍尔木兹海峡重开协议的要求，同时等待本周晚些时候公布的关键通胀数据。

title: Oil rises amid uncertainty over U.S.-Iran Strait of Hormuz deal
summary: Oil prices rose as traders assessed conflicting signals from U.S. and Iran negotiations over reopening the Strait of Hormuz, with growing concerns that a deal may not materialize soon.
content: Oil rose as traders assess mixed signals from the U.S. and Iran amid worries that a deal to open the Strait of Hormuz may not be coming anytime soon.

zh.title: 由于美国-伊朗霍尔木兹海峡协议的不确定性，油价上升
zh.summary: 由于交易员评估美国和伊朗关于重开霍尔木兹海峡谈判中的相互矛盾的信号，加上对协议可能无法很快达成的日益增长的担忧，油价上升。

title: Could your tattoo stop you from getting a job?
summary: Despite one-quarter of the UK population having at least one tattoo—including the sitting Prime Minister—tattoos remain controversial in hiring decisions. Workplace discrimination based on body art persists despite widespread prevalence.
content: A quarter of the UK population – including the new prime minister – have at least one tattoo, but they still divide opinion in the workplace.

zh.title: 你的纹身会妨碍你找到工作吗？
zh.summary: 尽管四分之一的英国人口至少有一个纹身（包括现任首相），但纹身在招聘决策中仍然存在争议。尽管纹身广泛存在，基于身体艺术的工作场所歧视现象仍然持续。

title: S&P 500 futures slip as traders watch for Strait of Hormuz deal, inflation data: Live updates
summary: Following the S&P 500's best week since April and a new all-time closing high on Friday, stock futures dipped as traders focused on developments in Strait of Hormuz negotiations and upcoming inflation data.
content: The three major indexes are coming off their best weeks since April, and the S&P 500 finished Friday at an all-time closing high.

zh.title: 交易员关注霍尔木兹海峡协议和通胀数据，标普500期货下跌：实时更新
zh.summary: 在标普500指数经历4月以来最好的一周并在周五创下历史新高之后，交易员关注霍尔木兹海峡谈判最新进展和即将公布的通胀数据，期货市场出现下滑。

title: ‘I’m easing into retirement’: I’m getting an $80,000 pension payout. Where can I invest it safely?
summary: A retiree receiving an $80,000 pension payout seeks guidance on safe investment strategies while planning to defer distributions from their 401(k) in coming years. The question addresses retirement income management and asset allocation.
content: “I expect to have several years before I take distributions from my 401(k) account.”

zh.title: "我在逐步退休"：我获得了8万美元的养老金支付。我在哪里可以安全地投资？
zh.summary: 一位退休人员在获得8万美元的养老金支付后，寻求关于安全投资策略的指导，同时计划在未来几年推迟401(k)分配。这个问题涉及退休收入管理和资产配置。
